module: Macro node 'Integrated' (hidden, canHaveGraph): represents a subgraph (target graph / macro) in the parent graph. Its pins are copied from the I/O nodes of the subgraph: inputs are written to the 'in' I/O node, outputs are read from the 'out' I/O node. Double-click in the editor to open the subgraph.
notes: In _onDeserialized (non-instance case), the getGraphNodeOffset offset is added to targetID and again in the mgr.graphs index; _postDeserialize adds it again: possible inconsistency.
_onSerialize uses the same code in both branches of the if (instance or not).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

setTargetGraph.desc: Binds the node to a graph: finds its macro/io 'in' and 'out' nodes, stores targetGraph/targetID and sets the name.

_postDeserialize.desc: Relinks the target graph via mgr.graphs[targetID + offset].

gatherPins.desc: Recreates the input/output pins from the pin lists of the I/O nodes.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves name, graphType, targetID and color.

_onDeserialized.desc: Reads back name, color, graph type and target (macro instance created from macroPath if needed).

drawMiddle.desc: Search icon with hover preview and watched variables.

doubleClicked.desc: Selects the target graph in the editor (except from a macro graph).

updatePins.desc: Copies the values of the input pins to the 'in' I/O node and those of the 'out' I/O node to the output pins.

_executionStarted.desc: Pushes the values of the hard-coded input pins to the 'in' I/O node.

_executionStopped.desc: Resets these values to nil in the 'in' I/O node.
